# Opera Concrete & Pavers

> Opera Concrete & Pavers builds concrete driveways, patios and pool decks, stamped concrete, paver driveways and patios, retaining walls and artificial turf for homes in the Orlando area and in Sarasota, Lakewood Ranch and Bradenton.

- Website: https://operaconcretepavers.com
- Orlando & Central Florida crew: https://operaconcretepavers.com/central-florida/
- Sarasota, Lakewood Ranch & Bradenton crew: https://operaconcretepavers.com/sarasota-manatee/
- Service area: Orlando, Kissimmee, Clermont, Oviedo, Winter Garden, Windermere and Central Florida; Sarasota, Lakewood Ranch, Bradenton, Venice and the Suncoast.
- Facts last reviewed: 2026-10-01

- Concrete Driveways: $6–$15 per sq ft installed (October 2026 Florida market range, not a quote)

- Concrete Pool Decks: $5–$15 per sq ft installed (October 2026 Florida market range, not a quote)
- Pool Deck Pavers: $12–$30 per sq ft installed (October 2026 Florida market range, not a quote)

- Sidewalks & Walkways: $7–$17 per sq ft installed (October 2026 Florida market range, not a quote)
- Concrete Slabs: $4–$10 per sq ft installed (October 2026 Florida market range, not a quote)
- Concrete Repair & Resurfacing: $3–$10 per sq ft (resurfacing) (October 2026 Florida market range, not a quote)
- Paver Sealing & Restoration: $1.50–$3.25 per sq ft (clean, re-sand, seal) (October 2026 Florida market range, not a quote)
- Retaining Walls: $15–$40 per sq ft of wall face (October 2026 Florida market range, not a quote)
- Artificial Turf: $10–$25 per sq ft installed (October 2026 Florida market range, not a quote)
